Preserve five independent white masters and128px/32px mineral-family comparison board. Complete actual built-in image_gen prompts and new iron-ore reference hashes recorded; older game icons used only for validation comparisons.

Gallery1076 exhibits, build/check without missing images; search, section filter and full preview checked.

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
